scenario: A medical clinic schedules six appointments on a single day in six consecutive time slots numbered 1 through 6. The appointments are with six patients: Harris, Irving, James, Karen, Laura, and Marcus. Each appointment is conducted by either Dr. Smith or Dr. Wong. Each patient is assigned to exactly one time slot, and each time slot has exactly one patient. The assignment of doctors to time slots follows specific constraints.

rules.description: Harris has an appointment in slot 1.
Irving has an appointment in slot 3.
James's appointment is before Karen's appointment.
If Laura is in slot 5, then Marcus is in slot 6.
